headings.title: SMTO-CMP-0042 — SMTO is still waiting for your answer, approval or sign-in

html:
SMTO-CMP-0042 — SMTO is still waiting for your answer, approval or sign-in

GUID: 0b572073-8286-47b0-bd5d-9a0ee3cd00ea
Slug: completion-required-interaction-pending
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • The AI tried to finish, but a question, approval or sign-in for this task is still waiting for you. SMTO won't mark the task done until you respond. The waiting request stays open.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look in the task for an item marked Needs input, Needs approval or Your reply is needed. That item is what's holding the task open.
  2. Answer the question, choose Approve once or Deny / stop task for an approval, or select Authorize in browser to finish a sign-in. Your response is the only thing that lets the waiting step move on.
  3. Before approving, read what the request will do and check the task's steps to make sure it hasn't already been done. This avoids approving the same change twice.

What success looks like

  • No item shows Needs input or Needs approval, and the task finishes as Completed.

If it still fails

  • Check whether the earlier action already happened before asking for it again. If you can't find the waiting item, open Technical details, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't start the task again; the request would stay open and work could repeat.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Successful completion was blocked because a required user, OAuth or approval wait, a required activity in waiting_user or waiting_approval, or a run status awaiting user interaction is still open.

What this means

  • Terminal success validation finds a required user/OAuth/approval wait, required waiting activity or a run state still awaiting interaction. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Terminal success validation finds a required user/OAuth/approval wait, required waiting activity or a run state still awaiting interaction.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact current interaction and required activity owner.

How to fix it

  • Inspect pending_wait, approval_pending, the background, dependency and foreground activities in waiting_user or waiting_approval, and the run status. Settle the matching interaction through its supported response (answer, approve or deny, OAuth authorization) before success is declared again; do not launch duplicate work to satisfy the check.
  • Open the pending interaction and provide its supported response or explicit decision before claiming completion.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect existing activities and their effects. Do not launch duplicate work to make the completion check pass.

How to verify the fix

  • The matching supported response/decision settles the required interaction before success is accepted.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
